#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation Whenever a public chain in the circle suddenly reveals a major security disaster, most people’s default mindset is: Oh no—has the underlying consensus been compromised? But recently I spent quite a bit of time tracing through Dusk’s technical architecture changes and several security incidents, and I found a rather frightening logic blind spot: the real danger zone that we should guard against is actually outside the consensus gate.

In the early days, when I saw Dusk separate DuskDS, DuskEVM, and the native runtime environment, I thought it was purely to cater to developers—just to make things simpler. But once the AEGIS patch plan for 2026 came out, my view immediately changed.

Take a look at what it fixed: VM sandbox escape, host deserialization vulnerabilities, Phoenix fee binding, and all kinds of issues related to BLS. These problems are varied and unrelated on the surface, but they all follow the same “chalkboard headline”: as long as the isolation barrier at the execution layer has any gaps, then no matter how “perfect” the underlying ledger is, the system will still record garbage. The execution boundaries have long become an inseparable part of consensus security.

A more typical cautionary example is cross-chain bridges. Recall the cross-chain wallet theft case in January 2026—did the hackers go after DuskDS, that tough nut? No. They bypassed it entirely and still managed to siphon off a large amount of assets.

How did the project team ultimately respond? They had no choice but to return to traditional risk controls: forcibly split signature authorization, event monitoring, and the payment process. They also tightly capped the limits of hot wallets. This clearly shows that even if the underlying accounting is accurate, you can never be sure that—during a cross-chain transfer—someone won’t intercept the process halfway.

After all these rounds of back-and-forth, I finally saw through Dusk’s security “bottom cards.” For a finance-grade base-layer network, you can’t just boast about how strong your consensus is. What the market truly wants is that from running code, to settlement, to cross-chain transfers—every step of the entire pipeline must not go off track.

So now, when I evaluate the potential and risks of modular Dusk, I’ve long stepped out of the dead end of “is consensus good or not.” What I’m really fixated on is this: every time funds cross these system modules, exactly how much additional trust cost is required? That’s the real make-or-break factor that determines whether it can go far.#eth $ETH

It looked impressive, like a clean architecture designed to make developers’ lives easier. It wasn’t until I carefully went through AEGIS’s vulnerability-fix logs from 2026 that I suddenly realized what was going on. Whether it was a VM sandbox bypass, a host deserialization issue, or strange behavior in Phoenix’s fee mechanism and BLS signatures, these very different vulnerabilities were all wildly pointing to the same thing: as long as there is a flaw in the execution-layer wall, no matter how strong the underlying consensus mechanism is, it is still useless.

The cross-chain bridge incident makes the problem even clearer. In the cross-chain wallet theft in January 2026, the hacker never even touched the core of DuskDS, yet still managed to steal the real money. Afterward, the official team was forced to use the most traditional, old-school fix: forcibly separating the permissions for signing, monitoring, and disbursing funds, and even putting a tight leash on the hot wallet’s capital. This plainly tells us that just because the ledger computes correctly does not mean the cross-chain transfer path is foolproof.

After going through all this, my understanding of Dusk’s security logic has completely changed. As a project trying to build major financial infrastructure, what retail users really care about is whether the entire process of funds moving from start to finish is stable. When I look at Dusk now, I no longer bother much with how flawless its consensus is. Instead, I focus on one thing: each time your assets cross these modular components, how much trust cost is secretly being added? That is the core metric that really matters when it comes to making a modular public chain work.#eth $ETH

How to use the $ETH/$BTC  ratio to judge rotation, instead of staring at the absolute price

Many people only look at how much ETH has risen and how much it has fallen. In fact, when allocating within the crypto market, “the ratio contains more information than the absolute price.”

◆ What the ratio tells you
The ETH/BTC number reflects capital preferences between two major assets.
- Ratio rising: capital is willing to take higher risk, usually accompanied by the start of an altcoin season
- Ratio falling: capital is moving toward $BTC  collapse, with risk-averse sentiment taking the lead, and altcoins generally weakening

So by looking at the ratio, you’re essentially reading the market’s “risk appetite direction,” not merely whether prices are going up or down.

◆ Three practical ways to judge
1. “The ratio makes a new low, but ETH’s absolute price hasn’t broken its previous low” — This suggests BTC is too strong rather than ETH being too weak; the situation is entirely different
2. “The ratio chops around in historical low territory for months” — Historically, this phase often corresponds to a window for medium-to-long-term positioning, but “low levels” can last a long time; don’t expect an immediate reversal
3. “The ratio surges with volume expansion” — Usually a signal that capital is overflowing from BTC; altcoin rallies often start later

◆ Factors that influence the ratio
- How fully expectations for Ethereum network upgrades are realized (when good news is already priced in, it often becomes a phase top)
- Differences in inflows between spot ETFs
- Staking yield and on-chain activity

◆ A reminder
The ratio is a relative metric and can’t be used alone as a buy/sell signal. When the ETH/BTC ratio falls, both may be dropping—only the magnitude differs. A “good-looking” ratio doesn’t necessarily mean you’ll profit.

Position management always comes before directional judgment. The above is my personal framework and does not constitute investment advice.

怎么用 $ETH/$BTC 比值判断轮动，而不是盯绝对价格

很多人只看 ETH 涨了多少跌了多少，其实在币圈内部做配置，「比值比绝对价格更有信息量」。

◆ 比值告诉你什么
ETH/BTC 这个数字反映的是资金在两个主流资产之间的偏好。
- 比值上行：资金愿意承担更高风险，通常伴随山寨季启动
- 比值下行：资金往 $BTC collapse，避险情绪占上风，山寨普遍更弱

所以看比值，本质是在看「市场的风险偏好方向」，而不是单纯的涨跌。

◆ 三个实用判断
1. 「比值创新低但 ETH 绝对价格没破前低」 —— 说明是 BTC 太强而非 ETH 太弱，性质完全不同
2. 「比值在历史低位区震荡数月」 —— 历史上这种阶段往往对应中长期布局窗口，但"低位"会持续很久，别指望马上反转
3. 「比值放量拉升」 —— 通常是资金从 BTC 外溢的信号，山寨行情往往滞后启动

◆ 影响比值的几个因素
- 以太坊网络升级的预期兑现程度（利好落地往往就是阶段性顶）
- 现货 ETF 的资金流入差异
- 质押收益率与链上活跃度

◆ 一个提醒
比值是相对指标，不能单独当买卖信号。ETH/BTC 走低时两个可能都在跌，只是跌幅不同——比值好看不等于你赚钱。

仓位管理永远排在方向判断前面。以上是个人框架，不构成投资建议。

What’s going on

First, the facts: this round of US-Iran negotiations has basically stalled, with no new progress, and neither side is giving in. At the same time, ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has clearly slowed—about 20% of global seaborne oil moves through this narrow passage. When shipping slows, traders start worrying about potential supply-side disruptions.

But interestingly, oil prices didn’t rise. The market is “talking” fear but “acting” reality: it doesn’t believe the strait will truly be shut. Safe-haven funds haven’t flowed into crude oil, nor have investors dumped risk assets. BTC is at $62,954, down only 0.18% in 24 hours; ETH $1,877.92, down 0.26%. Put simply, this volatility is basically a fake-out market.

One-sentence translation: the fuse for geopolitical risk is still there, but it hasn’t been lit yet—everyone is waiting for the next match.

Market impact

Short term: cautious sentiment, but not panic. Oil staying steady means inflation expectations haven’t been ignited. The Fed’s rate-cut narrative isn’t being disturbed, creating a rare quiet environment for the crypto market. BTC is consolidating around $62,954 on shrinking volume—neither bulls nor bears are pushing hard, and futures funding rates can’t stir up much.

Medium term: this is the key variable. Two paths—talks resume and risk appetite rebounds, which benefits all risk assets; or if something truly happens in the strait, the script repeats with oil prices spiking and inflation expectations rising, rate cuts delayed, and BTC being hit first. The current stalemate is essentially the market casting a “vote” for “no war”—but that vote can be changed at any time.

My view

Only after it breaks below today’s $62,954 line would we really have grounds to say conditions are weakening. If it holds, it just grinds on. 一句话翻译：地缘风险的雷还在，但引信没被点燃，所有人都在等下一根火柴。

我的观点很直接：观望，震荡对待，别自己吓自己。BTC这个位置属于典型的消息真空期走势，跌破今天$62,954这一线才谈得上转弱，守住就继续磨。地缘消息对币价历来是脉冲式影响——真出事当天砸一下，一周内基本修复完。所以别因为“美伊”两个字提前恐慌，也别赌它一定没事，管好仓位比猜方向重要。

title: ETH 的 2027 年升级 Hegotá 开始"海选"：66 项提案只有 FOCIL 确定入选，隐私三件套 8 月底见分晓
subTitle:
ETH 的 2027 年升级 Hegotá 开始"海选"：66 项提案只有 FOCIL 确定入选，隐私三件套 8 月底见分晓

8 月 17 日，ETH 在 1,880 美元附近横盘，开发者的注意力在另一个战场：以太坊核心开发者今天 14:00 UTC 开会，为 2027 年升级 Hegotá 划定范围。候选名单上 66 项提案，目前只有抗审查方案 FOCIL 确定入选；隐私、扩容、发行量调整都在争取剩余名额。

一、Hegotá 是什么

Hegotá 是以太坊下一个年度升级，计划 2027 年上线（ChainCatcher 8/16 口径）。上一个升级 Glamsterdam 已上线约 256 天，以 200M gas limit 为目标，计划年内完成部署（ChainCatcher 8/16、PrimeXBT 8/15 口径）。按路线图，Glamsterdam 部署完成后才轮到 Hegotá，这次筛选直接决定以太坊未来两年的技术走向（分析口径）。

截至 8 月 16 日，Hegotá 候选名单上有 66 项提案（以太坊基金会研究者 Toni Wahrstätter 8/16 X 动态口径）。需要说明的是，官方 Hegotá Meta EIP 里目前只有一项确定排期：FOCIL；另有平台统计 69 个相关条目，包含 65 项"已提议"、FOCIL"已排期"以及 3 项"已考虑、已拒绝或已撤回"等不同状态（baiyi 8/17、PrimeXBT 8/15 口径差异）。多数候选提案很可能进不了 Hegotá，核心团队要在"未来愿景"和"近期可交付"之间取舍（ChainCatcher 8/16 口径）。

二、为什么 FOCIL 先锁定席位

FOCIL（EIP-7805，Fork Choice enforced Inclusion Lists）的工作原理：验证者委员会发布一份必须包含进区块的交易清单，区块提议者保留出块角色，但不能再独自决定剔除哪些交易；attester 会对不当省略合规交易的区块投反对票（baiyi、PrimeXBT 口径）。设计背景是区块构建越来越专业化，单一提议者握有排除交易的能力，审查风险集中在提议者环节，FOCIL 把"必须纳入"变成协议规则（baiyi、PrimeXBT 分析口径）。

FOCIL 仍处草案阶段，尚未成为主网可用功能；它管的是抗审查，金额和地址不会因此变得不可见（baiyi 8/17 口径）。

三、隐私三件套：有戏但没定

Toni Wahrstätter 建议把三个 EIP 一起纳入 Hegotá，组成隐私应用的协议层工具箱（8/16 X 动态）。他写道："以太坊明年的升级 Hegotá 正在划定范围"（X 8/16，PrimeXBT 转述）：

1. EIP-8141 Frame Transactions：把交易验证、执行和 gas 支付分离，支持替代签名方案、密钥轮换和 gas 赞助（PrimeXBT、baiyi 口径）；
2. EIP-8250 Keyed Nonces：不再用单一 nonce 序列，让 Frame 交易有多个独立域，防止待处理交易阻塞后续交易（baiyi 口径）；
3. EIP-8272 Recent Roots：交易引用近期加密根，执行前验证，帮助隐私应用证明花费基于近期系统状态（baiyi 口径）。

注意口径：这三项是构建模块，不是"启用隐私模式"的开关，单独任何一项都不能让地址匿名（baiyi 8/17 明确说明）。决策节奏：8/13 核心开发者执行会议同意 8/25 breakout 上对比 EIP-8141 与 EIP-8130，目标 8/27 ACDE 会议作出决定（PrimeXBT 8/15 口径）。

四、扩容和发行也在名单上

Hegotá 的候选不止隐私：为 gas limit 从 200M 走向 600M 做准备，涉及数据资源重定价（EIP-8131、EIP-8279）与状态增长成本（EIP-8368）（ChainCatcher 8/16 口径）；8 秒出块时间（EIP-8198）、发行机制调整（EIP-8363）、反相关性惩罚（EIP-7716）也在讨论；zkEVM 与后量子密码学的首批 EIP 首次进入视野（ChainCatcher 8/16 口径）。这些议题大多没有确定排期，属于"在名单上"而非"已入选"（口径说明）。

五、筛选怎么进行

核心开发者设定两个时间点：8 月底前敲定 proposed-for-inclusion 名单，9 月 10 日前执行客户端团队提交各自的排序偏好；没有活跃 champion 的提案会被移出名单（PrimeXBT 8/15 口径）。今天的核心开发者会议（8/17 14:00 UTC）是持续筛选的一环（Yellow 8/15 口径）。社区意见仍参与其中，支持或反对某项提案的人可以通过公开讨论向核心开发者表态（ChainCatcher 8/16 口径）。

六、行情与背景

价格侧：8 月 17 日早间 ETH 约 1,883 美元（TokenPost 8/17 快照），部分平台口径 1,874 美元（Cointelegraph 中文 8/17），平台间有差异；同口径 BTC 约 63,047 美元，另一平台报 62,867 美元，整体在 6.3 万一线（TokenPost、Cointelegraph 中文 8/17）。ETH 年内约 -37%（Gate 复盘 8/16 口径：3,004→1,881）。期权市场 8/17 到期合约 max pain 约 1,880 美元，与现价接近（NADA 8/14 口径）。机构侧：SharpLink 通过 Lido 质押约 2 亿美元等值 ETH（NADA 8/14 口径）。全网 24 小时清算约 744 万美元（多头约 245 万），量级偏低（CoinGlass 数据，TokenPost 8/17 口径）。ETH 与 BTC 相关性仍高，升级消息短期未必能独立定价（分析口径）。

监管侧：SEC 取消原定加密监管规则会议，Reg Crypto 提案再度推迟。该提案原计划讨论企业如何通过代币融资，以及发行自有数字资产后如何最终退出 SEC 监管范围，暂停可能和 Clarity Act 有关（Odaily、ChainCatcher 8/17 口径）。升级是技术叙事，监管是定价变量，两条线并行（分析口径）。

七、口径与风险说明

1. 66 项候选为 8/16 时点口径，Meta EIP 仅 FOCIL 排期；提案状态随时变动；
2. 隐私三件套、扩容、发行调整均未确定纳入，最终名单以官方 Meta EIP 为准；
3. 价格与清算数据为 8/17 早间快照，平台间存在差异；ETH 年内跌幅为 8/16 复盘口径；
4. 本文不构成投资建议。

小结

Hegotá 是 2027 年的事，筛选今天就在进行：FOCIL 先占坑，隐私三件套 8 月底见分晓，扩容和发行调整还在排队。对 ETH 持有者，升级叙事对价格的拉动通常发生在预期阶段，落地前全是变量（分析口径）。技术面看，8/17 期权到期 max pain 1,880 与现价接近，短线波动温和；中线看，8 月 27 日 Frame Transactions 决定和 9 月 10 日前的排序名单是两个可跟踪的观察点。你会因为隐私升级关注 ETH 吗？评论区聊聊。

This round of selection directly determines Ethereum’s technical direction for the next two years (analysis perspective).

Early Monday morning, the market didn’t give anyone any face.

BTC $62,906, ETH $1,876—both closed slightly lower. The move wasn’t big, but it says everything about the structure: BTC has entered a bear trend, while ETH is chopping in a central range. This isn’t a pullback—it’s structural.

━━━ What you should be most wary of right now ━━━
In a bear trend, the most dangerous thing isn’t a sudden crash—it’s the warm-water grind. Every small rebound makes people feel, “It’s basically over.” Every bottom-buy is missing that one critical breath. Most people lose money here not because their judgment is wrong, but because they apply long-side logic to a short-side market.

ETH’s CHOP state is even more uncomfortable—no direction, getting slapped both ways, the kind of行情 that burns through account patience the fastest.

━━━ A few things about trading psychology ━━━
Fear makes you miss the bottom, greed makes you hold losses—but the real killer is “luckiness.” Try a small position today, add more to average down tomorrow, and the day after it becomes, “a long-term investment.” The essence of discipline is: admit you don’t know, then follow the rules.

━━━ Strategy direction ━━━
In a BTC bear trend, rebounds are windows to short—not signals to bottom-fish. In ETH’s range-bound chop, doing nothing is the best move. Cash is also a position.

Wait until the market shows its hand, then place your bet.

The most dangerous thing in a bear market is not the big drop, but this slow, relentless decline.

BTC at 2,870, ETH at 873. In the past 24 hours, neither has fallen by more than 1—everything looks calm, but under the surface there are strong undertows. The current assessment of the Phantian system: BTC is in a BEAR_TREND, and ETH is CHOP_MID. These two signals overlap to describe the same thing: the direction hasn’t reversed, but the bulls haven’t completely broken down either.

━━━ Whose market is it now ━━━

BEAR_TREND isn’t a reason to go all-in on staying in cash and waiting to die, nor is it a signal to chase short. It’s a reminder: control of this market is in the hands of the bears, but the bears are also waiting for the right position. CHOP_MID is even trickier—ETH doesn’t give you a reason to chase longs, and it doesn’t give a signal that it’s safe to short either. It’s mainly there to drain positions on both sides.

In this kind of market, most people end up doing one thing: trading too frequently. Every rebound feels like a turning point, and every pullback feels like a further big drop. The result—getting chopped back and forth, handing money to the market, and turning your positions over to your emotions.

━━━ Strategy direction ━━━

Keep position size light and wait for structure. If BTC can’t reclaim the prior high, then rebounds are opportunities to reduce exposure. Don’t touch ETH if it can’t keep up with BTC. Cash is your position; waiting is your trade.

I’ve seen too many people lose money going long here—not because they were wrong about direction, but because they entered too early.

BTC 2,870，ETH ,873。24小时各跌不到1%——看起来平静，实则暗流。梵天系统当前判断：BTC处于BEAR_TREND，ETH是CHOP_MID。这两个信号叠在一起，说的是同一件事：方向没反转，但多头也还没彻底崩。

━━━ 现在是谁的行情 ━━━

BEAR_TREND不是空仓等死的理由，也不是追空的信号。它是一个提醒：这个市场的主导权在空头手里，但空头也在等位置。CHOP_MID更麻烦——ETH既不给追多的理由，也不给放心做空的信号，专门拿来消耗双向仓位。

多数人在这种行情里会做一件事：频繁操作。每一波反弹都以为是转折，每一次回调都觉得要大跌。结果是——来回被割，钱交给市场，仓交给情绪。

━━━ 策略方向 ━━━

轻仓，等结构。BTC如果不能收复前高，反弹就是减仓机会。ETH跟不上BTC就不碰。现金是头寸，等待是交易。

见过太多人在这里做多亏的，不是因为看错，是因为太早。

💡 Impact on Judgment: Bearish. Geopolitical risk-off sentiment hasn’t fully digested yet. This uptick looks more like the market reacting inadequately.

Iran refuses to back down to Trump and keeps the Strait of Hormuz blockade in place. Global oil trade is disrupted, and BTC and ETH—risk assets—face downward pressure.

What’s going on
Trump publicly applies pressure, and Iran directly refuses, clearly stating that the status of the Strait of Hormuz blockade will remain unchanged. This strait carries about 20% of global oil transport. The longer the blockade drags on, the harder it becomes to restore oil trade, forcing the market to reprice the geopolitical risk premium. In simple terms: the stalemate hasn’t been resolved, and the market hasn’t accounted for this “bill” yet.

Market impact
Short term: Escalation is a textbook-level safe-haven signal. BTC $63,511 and ETH $1,904 are still up 0.6% and 1.15% respectively—this is lagging behavior, not actual repricing. If the stalemate carries past the weekend, selling pressure will likely show up.
Mid term: Oil prices staying elevated boosts inflation expectations, pushing back the pace of rate cuts; liquidity expectations for risk assets worsen accordingly.

My view
Bearish short term. For BTC, first focus on the $63,000 psychological level—if it breaks, sentiment could accelerate the downside. For ETH, it’s already relatively weak around $1,904; losing $1,900 often amplifies the drop. Don’t count on the safe-haven narrative—during the past few rounds of risk-off, BTC was mostly sold along with U.S. stocks. There’s basically one main risk: if both sides suddenly return to the negotiation table, the bearish logic could instantly become invalid.

I’ve seen too many people get taken out badly in this kind of market—not by a one-way move exploding them, but by getting ground down repeatedly until they’re exhausted.

Greed makes you chase higher, fear makes you cut losses, and then greed again—then fear again. This cycle won’t stop unless you set rules.

Discipline doesn’t mean you should never move. It means you only move where it’s worth it.

In a BEAR_TREND, going long is like sailing against the wind. Wait for structure reversal to be confirmed—then entering won’t be too late. In CHOP_MID, keep position size light, use tight stop-losses, and move fast in and out—or simply wait.
